name: Argument jitter across a two-call trajectory: format of a value carried from a tool result

messages.content: You are a restaurant booking assistant. Always look the reservation up with find_reservation before changing it, then apply the change with change_reservation_time. Never answer in prose without calling the tools. After the final tool result comes back, reply with exactly the single lowercase word: updated
Please move reservation RS-8842 an hour and a half later.

function.name: find_reservation
function.description: Look up a reservation by its confirmation code.

confirmation_code.description: The reservation's confirmation code exactly as the user gave it, e.g. RS-8842.

function.name: change_reservation_time
function.description: Move an existing reservation to a new start time on the same day.

new_time.description: The new start time for the reservation.
